hero.text: Picture books where your child makes the choices. Every story is built around decision intelligence, with emotional intelligence, social skills and behavioural skills woven in.
pim.hello: Hi, I’m Pim! In every story, you choose what happens next.
pim.skills: My favourite question: what would you choose?
pim.send: Send me your ending. I’ll send you a story card back!
tada.line: You talk with your child. The child tells the story and makes the choice.
tada.t.name: Talk
tada.t.text: Your child says what they see. You wait, then add one or two words.
tada.a.name: Ask
tada.a.text: One easy question. Then: “What could they do now?”
tada.d.name: Decide
tada.d.text: Your child picks what happens next and says why. No wrong answer.
tada.act.name: Act
tada.act.text: “What would you do?” Try it once in real life.
tada.small: TADA is the Telning team’s own way to talk about a story, based on dialogic reading.
send.text: Your child draws the ending they chose. Take a photo and Pim sends back a story card.
send.small: For grown-ups. First name and age only. Never a photo of your child.
trust.h2: Made by scientists, made for play.
trust.text: Every Telning book is created by our team of cognitive and behavioural scientists.
trust.1.t: The main focus of our scientists.
trust.3.t: The TADA way is based on dialogic reading.
email.line: Leave your email. Pim writes only when a new book is out.
email.label: Your email
email.consent: We use your email only for Telning news.
email.thanks: Thank you! Pim will write soon.
email.failed: Sorry, that did not work. Please try again.
